tasks.final_text: We recently went to a friends cabin for President's Day weekend. I was assigned to bring two breakfasts for the twenty people or so who would be staying there. I decided to make crepes, which is a family favorite. Before we left for the cabin, I vacillated back and forth over whether or not to make the crepes beforehand, or to make the crepes there. Eventually, I decided to just make the crepe batter.

Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The orginal facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of hisotrical signifacnace as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
